title: Agitation against CEC will go on till he is removed: Venugopal

ai.summary: Congress-led agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar continues until his removal to ensure electoral system impartiality, with plans for nationwide 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' campaign at panchayat level.

facts.claim: Congress-led agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar would continue until he was removed from the post
facts.quote: AICC general secretary K.C. Venugopal on Sunday (November said the Congress-led agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar would continue until he was removed from the post and the country's electoral system was made impartial and transparent.

facts.claim: Protests were continuing across states and districts with brief pause expected during Deepavali festival
facts.quote: Speaking to reporters in Alappuzha, Mr. Venugopal said protests were continuing across states and districts, with only a brief pause expected during the Deepavali festival.

facts.claim: Congress described November 1 rally in New Delhi as one of the strongest protests
facts.quote: He described the November 1 rally organised by the Congress in New Delhi as one of the strongest protests witnessed in the country, saying the party was fighting against Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

facts.claim: Congress will launch nationwide 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' campaign at panchayat level
facts.quote: As part of the campaign, the party would appoint a 'Vote Rakshak' (guardian) in every polling booth to scrutinise electoral rolls, identify people whose names had been deleted and visit their homes to help them get their names restored, he said.
